steps.caption: Set up the camera, microphone and canvas. Find the recording action.
Hide setup controls. Recording actions and navigation should stay reachable.
Select a take. Read its title and review it before choosing a destination.
Find a take by name. Selecting a file never starts playback.
During a take: find the timer, pause and Stop and save.
Pause the take. The timer must freeze and the action must say Resume.
Try Recordings during a take. Capture must continue and Stop must stay reachable.
Stop and save returns attention to the take. This save operation is mocked.
A saved take has an explicit review action. The local original stays available.
The same review workflow in light mode. Sharing remains a separate action.

disclosure: Captioned step captures of production Qt widgets. Synthetic camera/screen, files, engine, audio, playback, account and process boundaries. No native encoding, host capture, playback or upload. Elapsed time and save result are injected fixture events.
